name: MC Caro
description: '''Caroline Moore''' (born August 10, 1996), known professionally as '''MC Caro''', is a Liberian rapper and songwriter from [[New Kru Town]]. In 2018, she released her debut single "Bring Back Our Moni", which addresses [[corruption in Liberia]]. That same year, she gained recognition after releasing "Pro Poor", a viral freestyle track. MC Caro won Best Female Rapper of the Year at the 2020 [[Liberia Music Awards]]. She has released the albums ''King Caro'' (2021), ''My Way'' (2023), ''Still Broke'' (2024), and ''4lay active'' (2025).
